license: API reference is Paystack documentation. This inventory is original wording.
extractor: Hand-written from the Paystack API reference and the PaystackOSS paystack-python endpoint table. Each purpose is original wording. Risk is read, write, or money. scripts/gen-operations.mjs maps every route or records an exclusion.

routes.purpose: List transactions so a matcher can line payments up with open invoices.
Fetch one transaction by its numeric id.
Verify a transaction by the reference the merchant stored.
Read the timeline of attempts and events for one transaction.
Sum successful transaction volume over a date window.
Ask Paystack for an export of transactions in a date window.
Open a charge flow by creating an authorization URL the customer can pay.
notes: Initialize does not debit the customer by itself. It creates a charge flow, so it is classified as money movement and needs PAYSTACK_ALLOW_MONEY_MOVEMENT.
Pass a unique reference. Paystack uses reference to avoid a second charge for the same attempt.

routes.purpose: Debit a saved authorization for a positive subunit amount.
notes: Pass a unique reference. Paystack uses reference to avoid a second charge for the same attempt.

routes.purpose: Collect up to a subunit amount from a saved authorization, with an optional floor.
notes: Pass a unique reference. Paystack uses reference to avoid a second charge for the same attempt.

routes.purpose: List customers for invoice and identity checks.
Fetch one customer by email or customer code.
Create a customer record for later invoices and charges.
Update the name, phone, or metadata on a customer.
Submit identification details so Paystack can validate the customer.
Whitelist (allow) or blacklist (deny) a customer.
List payment requests, which Paystack uses as invoices.
Fetch one payment request by id or code.
Create a payment request the customer can pay later.
notes: Creating an invoice does not debit a saved card. The customer pays the request, so this is a write, not a money movement.

routes.purpose: Update the description, due date, or amount on a payment request.
Verify a payment request by its code or id.
Ask Paystack to notify the customer about a payment request.
notes: This asks Paystack to contact the customer. It does not send mail from this connector.

routes.purpose: Finalize a draft payment request so it can be paid.
Archive a payment request so it drops out of the open list.
Sum payment-request totals over a date window.
List settlements so cash application can see what Paystack paid out.
List the transactions that make up one settlement.
List refunds for collections and support questions.
Fetch one refund by id.
Refund a transaction, in full or for a positive subunit amount.
notes: Omit amount to ask Paystack for a full refund. A provided amount is a partial refund in subunits.

routes.purpose: List disputes so chasing can stop on a contested invoice.
Fetch one dispute by id.
List disputes filed against one transaction.
Ask Paystack for an export of disputes in a date window.
Update dispute details such as the refund amount you are willing to offer.
Attach written evidence to a dispute. Binary uploads are not sent.
Resolve a dispute as accepted or declined.
notes: merchant-accepted can cause Paystack to refund the customer. This stays a write, not a money call, because the refund is the dispute outcome rather than POST /refund. Treat it as financially sensitive.

routes.purpose: List transfers leaving the Paystack balance.
Fetch one transfer by id or transfer code.
Verify a transfer by the reference sent when it was created.
Send money from the Paystack balance to a transfer recipient.
notes: Pass a unique reference. Paystack uses reference so the same payout is not sent twice.

routes.purpose: Finalize a queued transfer with the one-time password Paystack sent.
Send one batch of transfers from the Paystack balance.
notes: Each item in transfers should carry its own reference so Paystack can dedupe the batch.

routes.purpose: List transfer recipients.
Fetch one transfer recipient by id or recipient code.
Create a transfer recipient for a bank account or mobile-money number.
Update the name or email stored on a transfer recipient.
Delete a transfer recipient so it cannot be paid.
Read the Paystack balance by currency.
Read balance-ledger lines for a date window.
List banks, including Ghana mobile-money when country and type say so.
Resolve an account number to the account name Paystack has on file.
List countries Paystack can process.
List states for address verification in one country.
Check that a bank account name matches the number. This does not change Paystack data.
notes: POST /bank/validate is a lookup. It is sent without the write switch because it does not create or change a merchant record and it does not move money.

routes.purpose: List subaccounts. Creating or editing them is out of scope.
Fetch one subaccount by id or code.
List plans. Creating or editing them is out of scope.
Fetch one plan by id or code.
List subscriptions. Enabling or disabling them is out of scope.
Fetch one subscription by id or code.
List products. Creating or editing them is out of scope.
Fetch one product by id.
List payment pages. Creating or editing them is out of scope.
Fetch one payment page by id or slug.
